test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who was given the Filmfare award for Best Choreography for the film Bajirao Mastani in 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birju Maharaj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** was an Indian **dancer, composer, and singer** of **Lucknow** "**Kalka Bindadin**" **Gharana** of **Kathak** dance in India.
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** was given the **Filmfare award** for Best Choreography for the song "**Mohe Rang Do Laal**" by **Bajirao Mastani**.
 
• In addition to performing the **Kathak** dance form, he also brought along the knowledge of **Hindustani classical music** and **percussion instruments**.
 
• He was noted to have been able to sing the **thumri** while dancing to it. 
 
• Maharaj also choreographed and composed music for many Indian movies. 
 
• His choreography for **Kamal Hassan** in **Vishwaroopam** won him the **National Film Award for Best Choreography** in 2012

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Birju Maharaj** was a recipient of the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second highest civilian honour, in **1986**.
 
• In **1964**, Maharaj was one of the youngest artists to receive the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, when he received the award at the age of 28.
 
• **Maharaj** opened his own dance school, **Kalashram**, in Delhi.
